plan.summary: BRO-5142: clear wrongShow on 57 real reviews of historical/sparse WE shows (no cast/creativeTeam in shows.json) that the BRO-4383 write guard flagged because the text never named the venue. Re-read by hand; 8 genuinely wrong texts stay flagged (a-kind-of-people observer/standard/scotsman, fishing-for-alaska viator, jane-eyre-off-west-end thestage (Colchester play), scenes-with-girls guardian/londontheatre1, toc-toc billboard). two-palestinians standard--nick-curtis skipped: it shares its URL with standard--unknown.json (duplicate).
steps: Set wrongShowManualClear true, then wrongShow false, on each re-read real review (bro-4429 pattern)
Guard fix in scripts/lib/wrong-article-screen.js stops re-flagging (venue-only metadata is sparseIdentity)
